import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem v3_gen_003 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≥ b) (h2 : a ≥ c) : a ≥ b + c := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem v3_gen_003 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≥ b) (h2 : a ≥ c) : a ≥ b + c := by
  have h3 : a - b ≥ 0 := by
    linarith [h1]
  have h4 : a - c ≥ 0 := by
    linarith [h2]
  have h5 : (a - b) + (a - c) ≥ a := by
    linarith [h3, h4]
  have h6 : a + (a - b - c) ≥ a := by
    linarith [h5]
  have h7 : a ≥ b + c := by
    linarith [h6]
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.v3_gen_003 = Nl2LeanCandidate.v3_gen_003 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
